bullets.text: AI Adoption Boost for Government - **Microsoft** partners with the US GSA to enhance AI tools for federal agencies.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New builds released for **Windows 11** Insiders, enhancing user experience and fixing bugs.
Windows 11, version 25H2 Preview - **Microsoft** releases the latest Windows 11 feature update for Insiders ahead of general availability.
Awesome Copilot MCP Server - A new tool from **Microsoft** simplifies searching and saving customizations for GitHub Copilot.
AI Agent Observability Insights - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of observability in ensuring AI agent reliability and performance.
Cloud-Based Ransomware Threat - **Microsoft** warns of evolving tactics by Storm-0501, focusing on cloud environments for ransomware attacks.
Endpoint Security Market Leader - **Microsoft** Defender retains top position in modern endpoint security market for the third consecutive year.
